task.title: P6-089: Add a cargo build -p three_rings step to validate.yml
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 2 — Ship gates). Original id: P6-089. Size: S. Specs: specs/delivery-pipeline.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**Add one `cargo build -p three_rings` step to `validate.yml` — the gate is structurally blind to `#![recursion_limit]` regressions.** Diagnosed 2026-07-26 (rustc 1.96.1); re-verified 2026-07-30 that the gate still has no such step (fmt + six clippy lines + test + `cargo leptos build --release`). The original entry was wrong on both its load-bearing claims: it is **not** Android-specific (a plain host `cargo build -p three_rings` reproduces it, as does a host wasm `frontend` build), and there is **one** limit that matters, not two — rustc names the crate to fix as *`app`* even when compiling `frontend` or `three_rings`, because the offending generic originates there. `cargo check`/`clippy` can never catch it: the overflow happens while computing the layout of a monomorphized async block, a codegen-time query `check` never runs. Headroom is 2× (fails at 128, clean at 256, committed value 512). What is genuinely uncovered is narrow — the gate's release build already codegens the wasm instantiation — so only a view tree reachable *solely* under `#[cfg(feature = "native")]` is unprotected. The runner already installs Tauri's Linux libs for the workspace clippy line, so this needs no new tooling.
